I've replied to Tobias in the thread: the ticket is **#8841**.

The number comes from his own message in #central-random on Oct 13 at 09:27. In it he said the West yard Door 2 double-booking still happens when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. That message talks about the Plains depots on his dealer account but never says "Marrow Fieldworks." I asked him to check it's the right account before it goes in the weekly notes. I couldn't find a Marrow Fieldworks ticket file that I'm allowed to read for him.

I didn't use the guessed number he sent me privately in our direct messages. It was only a guess, and he asked me to keep it private.
